description.zh: 备份客户端ID。备份客户端ID与ECS实例ID数量之和不能超过100个。
description.en: The IDs of Cloud Backup clients. The total number of Cloud Backup client IDs and ECS instance IDs cannot exceed 100.

description.zh: 用于跨账号备份的原账号RAM中创建的角色名。
description.en: The name of the RAM role that is created within the source Alibaba Cloud account and assigned to the current Alibaba Cloud account to authorize the current Alibaba Cloud account to back up data across Alibaba Cloud accounts.

description.zh:
跨账号备份类型。支持： 
- SELF_ACCOUNT：本账号备份
- CROSS_ACCOUNT：跨账号备份
description.en:
Specifies whether data is backed up within the same Alibaba Cloud account or across Alibaba Cloud accounts. Valid values:

*   SELF_ACCOUNT: Data is backed up within the same Alibaba Cloud account.
*   CROSS_ACCOUNT: Data is backed up across Alibaba Cloud accounts.

description.zh: 用于跨账号备份功能中的原账号ID。
description.en: The ID of the source Alibaba Cloud account that authorizes the current Alibaba Cloud account to back up data across Alibaba Cloud accounts.

description.zh: ECS实例ID。ECS实例ID与备份客户端ID数量之和不能超过100个。
description.en: The IDs of Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instances. The total number of ECS instance IDs and Cloud Backup client IDs cannot exceed 100.

descriptions.zh:
- 接口将创建一个后台的异步任务，调用云助手升级ECS中备份客户端。
- 任务结果可以通过DescribeTask获得。
- 任务超时时间为15分钟。
descriptions.en:
*   This operation creates an asynchronous job at the backend and calls Cloud Assistant to upgrade an HBR client that is installed on an ECS instance.
*   You can call the DescribeTask operation to query the execution result of an asynchronous job.
*   The timeout period of an asynchronous job is 15 minutes.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun hbr upgrade-backup-clients --instance-ids '[c-000000000000000000000]' --client-ids '[i-0xi5wj0000003j3bh2gj5]' --cross-account-type CROSS_ACCOUNT --cross-account-user-id 1283948272 --cross-account-role-name hbrcrossrole --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun hbr UpgradeBackupClients --region cn-hangzhou --CrossAccountUserId 1283948272 --CrossAccountRoleName hbrcrossrole --CrossAccountType CROSS_ACCOUNT --InstanceIds '["c-000000000000000000000"]' --ClientIds '["i-0xi5wj0000003j3bh2gj5"]'
